Contract ProcessSaleService::endSale(): Real {
          definition:
          salesLines:Set(SalesLineItem) = CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine, totalAmount:Real = salesLines->collect(s | s.Subamount)->sum()
            
            precondition:
          CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = bool and CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = false
            
            postcondition:
          CurrentSale.Amount = totalAmount and CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and result = CurrentSale.Amount
            
        }
